coordinate_contract.y_axis_note: Godot 2D matches this directly. Unity 2D and Three.js are Y-up: negate y at the render adapter boundary. Unreal is left-handed with Z-up: use (X = x, Y = -y, Z = 0) for a top-down plane and convert centimetres.
coordinate_contract.unit_note: All parameters are expressed relative to cell_size. Choose one metric per engine and keep ratios exact: radius = 0.17 cell, speed = 2.9 cell/s, separation radius = 0.391 cell (radius x 2.3).

depth_contract.rule: Keep this order explicitly; never rely on insertion order or texture streaming order across engines.

time_contract.render_interpolation: alpha = clamp((now - last_logic_step) / fixed_dt, 0, 1); position = lerp(prev, current, alpha)
time_contract.decimation: above 700 agents refresh direction/separation/trails every 3rd tick, movement every tick
time_contract.determinism: never use wall-clock time or frame delta for logic decisions

files.role: engine-neutral parameters, schemas and acceptance defaults
verified 36x24 C-corridor field export (cost, integration, flow)

sample_checks.verified_against: godot-flowfield/tools/smoke_flowfield.gd reports 835 reachable cells for the same sample

data: integration is int32 and uses the same INF sentinel
flow is a direction index 0..7 or 255 for none
all arrays are length cols*rows in y*cols+x order
goals are in bounds, walkable and unique
algorithm: for every reachable non-goal cell, flow points to a walkable neighbor with strictly smaller integration
diagonal moves require both orthogonal side cells to be walkable
unreachable cells keep INF and flow=none
same seed and same edit sequence produce bit-identical fields
simulation: no NaN in position/velocity over 600 fixed steps
no agent circle penetrates a blocked cell
same seed and same 90-step input sequence produce the same positions (tolerance 0 in the reference engine; document float tolerance per engine)
performance: record harness version, engine version, CPU/GPU, resolution, vsync state and load
report P50/P95/P99, worst and hitch counts, not just average FPS
use same-round normalisation when the machine is shared
relative gate example: optimised/baseline FPS >= 1.8 and P95 ratio <= 0.7

provenance.do_not_mix: Absolute FPS from T-20261121-009, T-20261121-011, godot-wfc and godot-steering were captured in different sessions and load conditions; only same-round relative results and engine counters are comparable.
